name: Alternatingvowelconsonantshift

description_json.name: AlternatingVowelConsonantShift
description_json.idea: A highly deterministic, character-by-character substitution cipher designed to maximize LLM reasoning accuracy while disrupting tokenization. It shifts all vowels (A, E, I, O, U) forward by 1 position in the vowel sequence (A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A) and shifts all consonants forward by 1 position in the consonant sequence (B->C, C->D, ..., Z->B, skipping vowels), preserving case. Numbers, spaces, and punctuation remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it to the next vowel in the sequence: A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A (and a->e, e->i, i->o, o->u, u->a).
2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the next consonant in the alphabetical order, skipping vowels: B->C, C->D, D->F, F->G, G->H, H->J, J->K, K->L, L->M, M->N, N->P, P->Q, Q->R, R->S, S->T, T->V, V->W, W->X, X->Y, Y->Z, Z->B (and lowercase equivalents).
3. If it is a number, space, punctuation, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U, case-insensitive), shift it to the previous vowel in the sequence: E->A, I->E, O->I, U->O, A->U (and e->a, i->e, o->i, u->o, a->u).
2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the previous consonant in the alphabetical order, skipping vowels: C->B, D->C, F->D, G->F, H->G, J->H, K->J, L->K, M->L, N->M, P->N, Q->P, R->Q, S->R, T->S, V->T, W->V, X->W, Y->X, Z->Y, B->Z (and lowercase equivalents).
3. If it is a number, space, punctuation, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
